items.title: Nvidia, Broadcom, and Micron stocks decline as Anthropic goes public
items.summary: Chip giant Nvidia slid into the red on Thursday, along with Broadcom and other AI trade names after Anthropic shares began trading.

items.title: AMD stock drops after Hunterbrook Media raises export control concerns
items.summary: Hunterbrook Media has raised questions about AMD's exposure to US export controls related to China.

items.title: Blacklisted Chinese server maker kept getting AMD firmware updates: Hunterbrook
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss reporting by Hunterbrook alleging AMD (AMD) kept supplying firmware updates to a U.S.-blacklisted Chinese server maker, raising export-control questions and causing its stock to sink.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Techs Slide, Anthropic Retreats After Ugly Market Reversal To New Lows
items.summary: Tech futures fell after the market suffered an ugly reversal, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq hitting new lows. Anthropic retreated late after rising its IPO debut.

items.title: Dan Ives Calls Tech Selloff a Panic Moment but Anthropic IPO Shows Proof of Demand
items.summary: Dan Ives says the tech selloff is panic, not a broken AI thesis, as the Anthropic IPO closes up 17% on day one.

items.title: Nikkei 225 Falls 4.5% and SoftBank Plunges 15% as Wall Street’s AI Selloff Puts Asian Stocks on Track for Their Worst Week Since 2020
items.summary: The Nikkei 225 fell 4.5% in Friday's morning session and SoftBank plunged 15% as Wall Street's AI selloff reached Asia. Taiwan lost 10% in two sessions. Here is what fell most, why, and what it means for U.S. holders of Asia funds.

items.title: Nasdaq, Dow, S&P 500 Futures Slip As Anthropic’s Record Debut Fails To Lift AI Stocks: SLV, GLD, AMD, NVDA In Focus
items.summary: Anthropic has quickly become one of the most valuable public companies in the world after its shares began trading much above its allocation price of $83.

items.title: AMD Just Plunged Almost 8%, Lost $67 Billion and Kept Falling After Hours. A Short Seller Says It Shares Nvidia’s China Risk
items.summary: AMD fell almost 8% on Thursday, erasing roughly $67 billion of market value, and slid again after hours. A short seller's China report, investors selling to buy Anthropic and a market reversal all hit at once. Here is what each one means for holders.
